decisions.reason: The waterproof lined safety shoe range fits the firm's core safety-footwear direction and has absorbed tooling, certification and catalogue investment, and the missing archives point to a website gap rather than to failure, so commitment and sunk costs favour keeping it.

ESD occupational shoes involve costly certification and serve a stable industrial niche central to the firm's announced positioning, and any weak results can be attributed to temporary pandemic-related demand drops, so management would persist.

As a full safety shoe series, it represents a visible and sizable commitment to the firm's core line, and disappointing sales in 2020–2021 can plausibly be blamed on COVID and supply-chain disruptions, so escalation of commitment supports keeping it.
